title: Unit 5 第三课时 基础达标与综合拓展

questions.prompt: Miss Lin asks us to ______ [ækt] out the stories.
questions.translation: 林老师让我们把这些故事表演出来。
questions.explanation: 根据音标 [ækt] 可知此处应填动词 act。

questions.translation: 露西亚对大自然感兴趣。
questions.explanation: 根据音标 ['neɪtʃə(r)] 可知此处应填名词 nature。

questions.prompt: Books can open your ______ [maɪnd] and make you think.
questions.translation: 书籍可以开阔你的思维并让你思考。
questions.explanation: 根据音标 [maɪnd] 可知此处应填名词 mind。

questions.prompt: They ______ [fɔːl] in love with this city.
questions.translation: 他们爱上了这座城市。
questions.explanation: 根据音标 [fɔːl] 可知此处应填动词 fall。

questions.translation: 在眼皮底下发现野生动植物。
questions.explanation: 根据音标 [dɪ'skʌvə(r)] 可知此处应填动词 discover，位于句首首字母大写。

sections.title: II. 用括号内所给词的适当形式填空
sections.instruction: 用括号内所给词的适当形式填空
sections.passage:
1. Cindy loves [1] (hike) and she can take photos.
2. I can't cook but I want to cook for [2] (I) family.
3. Alice is good at [3] (tell) stories.
4. Every weekend Mary goes to the park to collect plants and [4] (insect).
5. Every one in our class likes [5] (China) food.
6. Join our book club! It's more than [6] (read).
7. Judy wants to join a club and make [7] (friend) there.
8. Students can learn to cook [8] (they) favourite food in the cooking club.
9. Which club [9] (be) you in at school?
10. I'm [10] (real) interested in science.

questions.translation: 辛迪喜欢徒步旅行，她会拍照。
questions.explanation: love doing sth. 表示“喜欢做某事”，故选 hiking。

questions.translation: 我不会做饭，但我想为我的家人做饭。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词 family 应用形容词性物主代词 my，故选 my。

questions.translation: 爱丽丝擅长讲故事。
questions.explanation: be good at doing sth. 中 at 是介词，后接动名词 telling，故选 telling。

questions.translation: 每个周末玛丽去公园收集植物和昆虫。
questions.explanation: insect 是可数名词，此处表泛指应用复数 insects，故选 insects。

questions.translation: 我们班每个人都喜欢中国食物。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词 food 应用形容词 Chinese，故选 Chinese。

questions.translation: 加入我们的读书俱乐部吧！它不仅仅是阅读。
questions.explanation: than 是介词，后接动名词 reading，故选 reading。

questions.translation: 朱迪想加入一个俱乐部并在那里交朋友。
questions.explanation: make friends 是固定短语，意为“交朋友”，故选 friends。

questions.translation: 学生们可以在烹饪俱乐部学习烹饪他们最喜欢的食物。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词短语 favourite food 应用形容词性物主代词 their，故选 their。

questions.translation: 你在学校参加哪个俱乐部？
questions.explanation: 主语是 you，be 动词应用 are，故选 are。

questions.translation: 我对科学真的很感兴趣。
questions.explanation: 修饰形容词 interested 应用副词 really，故选 really。

sections.title: III. 为下列问题选出正确回答
sections.instruction: 为下列问题选出正确回答

questions.prompt: 1. What can you do in a book club?
options: I want to join the art club. I like drawing pictures.
She wants to act out stories and read with feeling.
He can cook delicious Chinese food.
Because I want to learn to play the piano.
I can read and talk about books.
questions.translation:
1. 你能在读书俱乐部做什么？
2. 你想加入哪个俱乐部？
3. 杰克会做什么菜？
4. 方方想在戏剧俱乐部做什么？
5. 你为什么想加入音乐俱乐部？

A. 我想加入美术俱乐部。我喜欢画画。
B. 她想表演故事并带感情地朗读。
C. 他会做美味的中餐。
D. 因为我想学弹钢琴。
E. 我可以读书并谈论书籍。
questions.explanation: 问句询问在读书俱乐部能做什么，答语应说明读书活动，故选 I can read and talk about books.。

questions.prompt: 2. Which club do you want to join?
options: I want to join the art club. I like drawing pictures.
She wants to act out stories and read with feeling.
He can cook delicious Chinese food.
Because I want to learn to play the piano.
I can read and talk about books.
questions.translation: 你想加入哪个俱乐部？
questions.explanation: 问句询问想加入哪个俱乐部，答语应提及具体俱乐部，故选 I want to join the art club. I like drawing pictures.。

options: I want to join the art club. I like drawing pictures.
She wants to act out stories and read with feeling.
He can cook delicious Chinese food.
Because I want to learn to play the piano.
I can read and talk about books.
questions.translation: 杰克会做什么食物？
questions.explanation: 问句询问杰克会做什么食物，答语应提及食物，故选 He can cook delicious Chinese food.。

questions.prompt: 4. What does Fang Fang want to do in a drama club?
options: I want to join the art club. I like drawing pictures.
She wants to act out stories and read with feeling.
He can cook delicious Chinese food.
Because I want to learn to play the piano.
I can read and talk about books.
questions.translation: 方方想在戏剧俱乐部做什么？
questions.explanation: 问句询问方方想在戏剧俱乐部做什么，答语应提及表演故事，故选 She wants to act out stories and read with feeling.。

questions.prompt: 5. Why do you want to join a music club?
options: I want to join the art club. I like drawing pictures.
She wants to act out stories and read with feeling.
He can cook delicious Chinese food.
Because I want to learn to play the piano.
I can read and talk about books.
questions.translation: 你为什么想加入音乐俱乐部？
questions.explanation: 问句以 Why 开头询问原因，答语应用 Because 引出，故选 Because I want to learn to play the piano.。

sections.title: IV. 阅读下面短文，用括号内所给词的适当形式填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，用括号内所给词的适当形式填空
sections.passage:
There are many different clubs in [1] (we) school. For example, we have music club, the sports club and the science club.
The sports club is the most popular (受欢迎的). In this club, students can do different kinds of sports like [2] (swim), playing ping-pong and running. Most students likes playing ping-pong best. It makes them [3] (health). Many of them like Chinese ping-pong players. Girls are more [4] (interest) in music. Therefore, more girls join the music club. They can sing and dance there. The music teacher, Miss Wang, can play the erhu. And she is also good at dancing. In the science club, students can make many models. They can also watch some scientific movies. There they can study a lot about science. For example, they can make a tool (工具) to water the [5] (plant).

questions.translation: 在我们学校有许多不同的俱乐部。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词 school 应用形容词性物主代词 our，故选 our。

questions.translation: 在这个俱乐部里，学生们可以做不同种类的运动，比如游泳、打乒乓球和跑步。
questions.explanation: like 是介词，后接动名词 swimming，故选 swimming。

questions.translation: 它使他们保持健康。
questions.explanation: make sb. + 形容词表示“使某人……”，此处应用形容词 healthy 做宾语补足语，故选 healthy。

questions.translation: 女孩们对音乐更感兴趣。
questions.explanation: be interested in 是固定短语，意为“对……感兴趣”，主语是人，故选 interested。

questions.translation: 例如，他们可以制作一个工具来给植物浇水。
questions.explanation: plant 常用复数表示类指植物，故选 plants。

sections.title: V. 完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项
sections.passage:
In the early morning, Pan Chayinhua is singing the grand song (大歌) of the Dong ethnic group in Xiaohuang Village in Guizhou Province. Pan, 80, is a [1] and she is a national inheritor (继承人) of the grand song.
In Pan's village, singing is a part of life for villagers. "Whether (无论) we are busy or free, [2] or sad, we can get relaxed by singing," Pan said with a feeling of pride (自豪).
Every Spring Festival, Xiaohuang Village becomes a lively place of interest. People [3] their traditional clothes to [4] visitors from all over the country. Many singing groups sing songs to [5] the visitors.
Wu Dingfeng started a cooperative (合作社) in 2014. The cooperative [6] a platform (平台) to sing, [7] each other and help each other. This can help keep the special culture, and it can [8] help everyone to show their talent.

questions.translation: 80岁的潘是一位歌手，也是大歌的国家级传承人。
questions.explanation: 根据上文“is singing the grand song”可知她是一位歌手，故选 singer。

questions.translation: 无论我们是忙碌还是空闲，高兴还是悲伤，我们都可以通过唱歌来放松。
questions.explanation: 根据前后词义对比，busy 对应 free，sad 对应 happy，故选 happy。

questions.translation: 人们穿着传统服装来迎接来自全国各地的游客。
questions.explanation: 穿衣服用动词 wear，故选 wear。

questions.translation: 人们穿着传统服装来迎接来自全国各地的游客。
questions.explanation: 迎接/会见游客用 meet，故选 meet。

questions.translation: 许多歌唱小组唱歌来欢迎游客。
questions.explanation: 欢迎游客用 welcome，故选 welcome。

questions.translation: 合作社提供了一个唱歌、互相学习和互相帮助的平台。
questions.explanation: 提供平台用 give，主语 cooperative 是单数第三人称，故选 gives。

questions.translation: 合作社提供了一个唱歌、互相学习和互相帮助的平台。
questions.explanation: 与后面的 help each other 并列，互相学习用 learn from，故选 learn from。

questions.translation: 这可以帮助保护特殊的文化，它也可以帮助每个人展现他们的才华。
questions.explanation: 位于句中表示“也”，应用 also，故选 also。

sections.title: VI. 语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，用括号内所给词的适当形式填空
sections.passage: My name is Linda Miller. I am 13 [1] (year) old now. I like to play [2] (sport). I like volleyball and ping-pong. I often play [3] (they) with my friends after school. I want [4] (join) a sports club. I have a brother [5] a sister. [6] (they) names are Jim and Mary. Jim likes to swim and he wants to join the [7] (swim) club. My sister Mary [8] (like) to sing and dance. She wants to join the music club. My classmate Bob likes to play chess. He is [9] a chess club now. What club do you want to join? [10] (tell) me, please.

questions.translation: 我现在13岁了。
questions.explanation: 表达年龄“13岁”用 years old，故选 years。

questions.translation: 我喜欢做运动。
questions.explanation: play sports 是固定短语，意为“做运动”，故选 sports。

questions.translation: 我经常在放学后和我的朋友们一起玩它们。
questions.explanation: 动词 play 后面接宾格代词 them 指代前文的排球和乒乓球，故选 them。

questions.translation: 我想加入一个运动俱乐部。
questions.explanation: want to do sth. 表示“想要做某事”，故选 to join。

questions.translation: 我有一个哥哥和一个妹妹。
questions.explanation: 前后是并列关系，用 and 连接，故选 and。

questions.translation: 他们的名字是吉姆和玛丽。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词 names 应用形容词性物主代词 Their，位于句首首字母大写，故选 Their。

questions.translation: 吉姆喜欢游泳，他想加入游泳俱乐部。
questions.explanation: 此处用动名词作定语修饰 club，即 swimming club，故选 swimming。

questions.translation: 我妹妹玛丽喜欢唱歌和跳舞。
questions.explanation: 主语 My sister Mary 是单数第三人称，一般现在时中动词用 likes，故选 likes。

questions.translation: 他现在在一个国际象棋俱乐部里。
questions.explanation: 在俱乐部里用介词 in，故选 in。

questions.translation: 请告诉我。
questions.explanation: 祈使句以动词原形开头，位于句首首字母大写，故选 Tell。

sections.title: VII. 阅读理解
sections.passage:
> **Club Members Wanted**
> This term, here are some clubs for you to join!
>
> You can choose to join:
> - Reading
> - Cooking
> - Singing
> - Drawing
> - Photography
> - Football
>
> • The teachers in the clubs are excellent. They will teach you more knowledge and skills.
> • There are only a few spaces (名额) for each club. Sign up (报名) early to get your first choice!
>
> **Time:** March 3rd: 9:00 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.
> **Place:** the Students' Center
> For more information, please call Mrs. Green at 998-666.

questions.prompt: 1. You can't choose to join the ________ Club this term.
questions.translation:
1. 这学期你不能选择加入______俱乐部。
2. 关于这些俱乐部你知道些什么？
3. 你可以在3月3日的______报名加入俱乐部。
4. 如果你想了解更多关于俱乐部的信息，你可以______。
5. 你最可能在哪里读到这段文字？
questions.explanation: 根据短文中的俱乐部列表（Reading, Cooking, Singing, Drawing, Photography, Football）可知没有 Running，故选 Running。

questions.prompt: 2. What do you know about the clubs?
options: There are three clubs in all.
There are many spaces for each club.
The teachers teach a little knowledge.
questions.translation: 关于这些俱乐部你知道些什么？
questions.explanation: 根据“The teachers in the clubs are excellent.”可知老师们很优秀，故选 There are excellent teachers.。

questions.prompt: 3. You can sign up to join the club at ________ on March 3rd.
questions.translation: 你可以在3月3日的什么时候报名加入俱乐部？
questions.explanation: 根据“Time: March 3rd: 9:00 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.”可知下午3:00在时间范围内，故选 3:00 p.m.。

questions.prompt: 4. If you want to know more information about the clubs, you can ________.
questions.translation: 如果你想了解更多关于俱乐部的信息，你可以______。
questions.explanation: 根据“For more information, please call Mrs. Green at 998-666.”可知打电话，故选 make a call。

questions.prompt: 5. You can most probably read the text from ________.
questions.translation: 你最可能在哪里读到这段文字？
questions.explanation: 这是一则关于学校俱乐部招募成员的通知，最可能来自学校网站，故选 a school website。
